title: Rate Lock Commitment Allowances for Extension Days Borne by Larkspur
content:
Two **Rate Lock Commitment** allowances set how many extension days Larkspur Home Lending can bear at no cost to the borrower.

- **Complimentary extension days**: the days of the first extension that Larkspur grants at no cost. A figure of 0 means none.
- **Lender-delay allowance**: the maximum number of extension days whose cost Larkspur bears for a documented appraisal delay.

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Complimentary extension days (first extension) | Lender-delay allowance (extension days) |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | 0 | 10 |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 0 | 15 |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | 0 | 15 |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | 5 | 15 |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 7 | 15 |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 7 | 30 |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | 10 | 30 |

### Notes

- The 15-, 30- and 45-day locks grant no complimentary days (0).
- The complimentary days belong to the first extension only. The lender-delay allowance is stated in extension days for the lock as a whole.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* under the Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock, the first extension can carry up to 5 complimentary days. Under the Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock, it carries none.
